metadata.title: Sprintable — Ship with AI agents
metadata.description: Open-source PM surface for teams shipping with AI. Turn agent claims into human-verified outcomes.

hero.headline:
Ship what's <g>verified</g>,
not what's claimed
hero.subheadline: Approval gates and easy review turn what agents claim into verified outcomes. The open-source organization OS for dev and product teams.
hero.operatingPrinciple: Design your workflow, register it as stories — agents and humans execute in the same loop.

trust.label: Claimed vs Verified
trust.title:
Nothing is verified
until you approve it
trust.subtitle: Every run is traced. Every decision is recorded.

step1.title: Check the evidence
step1.desc: Diffs, test results, logs — review everything the agent submitted in one view.

step2.title: Approve or reject in one click
step2.desc: When you're done reviewing, pass the gate or send it back with a single click.

step3.title: Signed by a human
step3.desc: The approver is recorded as a signature, and a Verified seal is attached to the outcome.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.desc: A review assistant that flags risk signals and checkpoints before you start reviewing.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: Every task passes through one loop
howItWorks.subtitle: Humans and AI on the same board — from registration to verification.

step1.title: Register a story
step1.desc: Break goals into stories and assign them to a human or an agent.

step2.title: Agents execute
step2.desc: BYOA agents connect over MCP and do the work.

step3.title: Approve at the gate
step3.desc: Check the outcome and its evidence, then approve or reject in one click.

step4.title: Recorded as verified
step4.desc: Only verified outcomes enter the org record, signed by a human.

customers.title: For teams shipping with AI
customers.subtitle: Turn scattered AI work into one verifiable loop.

cards.title: Dev teams
cards.desc: Agent PRs and human reviews meet on the same board.
cards.fit: Best when you run multiple coding agents but verifying results is the bottleneck.

cards.title: Product teams
cards.desc: PM, Dev, and QA see progress and evidence in the same delivery loop.
cards.fit: Best when you need verified progress, not 'done' reports.

cards.title: Founder-operators
cards.desc: Operate faster and more precisely with a lean team.
cards.fit: Best when you want to start free with BYOA and move to managed when it's worth it.

model.title: Run it yourself—or let us run it for you
model.subtitle: Start open source and move to managed when you need it.

byoa.title: Connect your own (BYOA)
byoa.desc: Connect your existing models and tools via MCP. Start free.
bullets: Great for pilots, founders, and technical teams validating the workflow
MCP-native connection points and a free entry path
Best when one or two agents are enough and you control the runtime

serving.title: Managed hosting
serving.desc: Reduce operational overhead with priority support and an SLA.
bullets: Focus on your team without infrastructure overhead
Scalable hosting as your team grows

model.bridge: Start lean, upgrade when managed hosting is worth paying for. BYOA is the low-friction entry. Managed hosting is for teams that want to run workflows without infrastructure overhead.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that grows with your team
pricing.subtitle: Start free with self-hosting and add only the support you need.
pricing.wedge: SSO · Audit logs · SLA — starting at $149, no sales call required.
pricing.footnote: All plans include unlimited stories, epics, sprints, and BYOA agent seats. Billed monthly or annually.

finalCta.title: Ship only what's verified
finalCta.desc: Self-host with a single command. Approval gates and review are built in from day one.
